rules.rule: Persist a SourceRecord pointing to the ViralTrac query/run/artifact/export and its evidence/coverage metadata; create only bounded Observations needed by the active job. Do not bulk-copy ViralTrac operational history into the BusinessOS workspace.

Use the authoritative ViralTrac result as SourceRecord evidence; publish canonical MetricObservation values only through the owning MetricDefinition, and let core.measurement.evaluate-outcome form the BusinessOS conclusion with causal limits.
Attach ViralTrac proposal/preview references in ActionPacket/Approval extensions; do not create ChangeEvent until execution/effect evidence exists.
Map the receipt/effect reference into ChangeEvent extensions and verification evidence; distinguish proposed, provider-accepted, executed, delivered/exposed, and outcome-observed states.
Treat the packet as evidence/advice. Preserve its evidence brief, constraints, confidence and measurement plan; the semantic owner decides whether to promote an Insight or Opportunity.

Treat the occurrence as a trigger/evidence object only. Preserve authoritative event/trace/root/parent/subscription/evaluation identities in Event and EventReactionDecision, deduplicate/loop-check before routing, and never interpret delivery as permission to mutate external state.
